review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (plus two context-only variants each). Both items measure vocabulary knowledge and usage; their label, topic and module metadata are appropriate. Recommend PASS for both.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure literal information retrieval/details from short texts; metadata is appropriate and coherent. Verdict: 2 PASS.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 P4 Chinese-reading items (part 3 of 5). Both items require making inferences from a character's actions (one about personal trait, one about cause/reason). Metadata (label, topic, module) correctly describe the skills assessed; no substantive changes needed.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 canonical items (each with two context-only variants) for P4 Chinese reading, part 4. Both items measure the skills indicated by their metadata and require no substantive changes.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (each with two context-only variants). Both items measure the labeled reading comprehension skills appropriately; no substantive metadata changes required.

reviews.reason: The item asks for the closest meaning of the word 「周全」, assessing word-meaning recognition (vocabulary). The label '字詞理解', topic '字詞理解與運用', and module '基礎掌握' accurately describe this skill.

The item asks which sentence appropriately uses 「周全」, assessing vocabulary-in-context and word usage/collocation. The label '詞語運用', topic '字詞理解與運用', and module '基礎掌握' accurately reflect the measured skill.

The item asks students to identify what the sentence explicitly states (locating the information/main idea of a single-sentence passage). The topic '訊息定位', label '訊息定位' and module '理解與應用' correctly describe this literal information-retrieval skill.

The item requires extracting a specific detail (the latest arrival time) from a short announcement. Both '訊息定位' (topic) and '細節理解' (label) accurately describe the skill of locating explicit textual details; the module '理解與應用' is also appropriate.
題幹要求由行為推論人物特質（查看天氣和路線→有準備），即人物推論／人物與原因推論，屬於情境推理能力。提供的 label、topic 和 module 精確且教育上合適。
題幹要求推論行為背後的原因（先了解資料才決定→希望作出較合適的選擇），即原因推論，屬於人物與原因推論範疇，適合作為情境推理題目。現有 metadata 與實際測量的技能一致。
The item asks students to recognise a rhetorical device (personification) in a sentence. The label '修辭手法', topic '語境、修辭與句意' and module '理解與應用' accurately describe this skill at a basic level.
The item requires straightforward sentence-level comprehension (identifying the main meaning). The label '句意理解', topic '語境、修辭與句意' and module '理解與應用' suitably match the measured skill.
The item asks students to identify the main idea/central message of a short passage. The label '主旨辨認', topic '整合閱讀' and module '理解與應用' correctly describe this skill and its instructional level.
The item asks students to recognise the organisational pattern (sequence of steps). The label '段落關係' and topic '整合閱讀' within the '理解與應用' module accurately reflect recognising text structure/sequence.
